question: Find the mean for the following data: 12, 3, 18, 17, 4, 9, 17, 19, 20, 15, 8, 17, 2, 3, 16, 11, 3, 1, 0, and 5.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the Assumed Mean Deviation method to solve it mentally.

Let the Assumed Mean be 10.

Sum of deviations = (+2) + (−7) + (+8) + (+7) + (−6) + (−1) + (+7) + (+9) + (+10) + (+5) + (−2) + (+7) + (−8) + (−7) + (+6) + (+1) + (−7) + (−9) + (−10) + (−5) = 0

Since the net deviation is 0, the Actual Mean is exactly equal to the Assumed Mean.

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**
